text: Which consultancies in Canberra are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

sections.text:
Here is a roundup of some of the best consultancies in Canberra (and those serving the ACT region) for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation:

---

## 🏆 Top Consultancies for Business Workflow Automation & Power Automate in Canberra

---

### 1. 🔷 Power Platform Experts Canberra
**Website:** powerplatformexperts.com.au
Canberra's leading Power Platform consultants, with 25+ years of helping businesses streamline operations with Power BI, Apps, Pages, and Automate solutions.
Their local team of Microsoft-certified Power Platform specialists offer expertise in Power Automate workflows, Power Apps creation, Power BI data visualisation, and Power Pages deployment.

Their Canberra team specialises in Microsoft Power Platform solutions for government departments and local organisations, with a focus on developing secure, compliant automation and business solutions.

Their highly experienced consulting team is renowned for business process optimisation, responsive technical support, innovative low-code solutions, customised training workshops, and comprehensive implementation services across Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and Power Pages.

---

### 2. 🔷 Office Experts Group (Microsoft Consultants Canberra)
**Website:** officeexperts.com.au

Operating since 2000, they are a nationwide organisation with consultants based in Canberra, and have helped small businesses, government departments and organisations all over the ACT streamline their business processes.

They build Power Automate workflows that replace email chains and manual handoffs between teams, Power BI dashboards connected to departmental data sources for real-time reporting, and Power Apps that give field staff or internal teams a proper interface instead of a shared spreadsheet.

---

### 3. 🔷 OfficePro Consulting
**Website:** officeproconsulting.com.au
Microsoft-certified, Australian-based, and operating as a one-stop partner for every system.
From Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps to custom code automation with Python, .NET and PowerShell, they match the right platform to your process.
They use Power Automate to build approval workflows, invoice processing, and data sync between Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, and third-party systems like Xero and MYOB.
They deliver workflow automation consulting Australia-wide, including Canberra.

---

### 4. 🔷 AMBR IT (Ambrit)
**Website:** ambrit.com.au/canberra
They design and build intelligent automation using Power Automate, Zapier, and custom solutions that free your team to focus on high-value work — specifically for Canberra organisations.
They are technology-agnostic, meaning they recommend the best fit for your business, not the highest margin solution.

They are well-suited to Canberra businesses dealing with Commonwealth contract reporting and government-related workflows.

---

### 5. 🔷 RightLink
**Website:** rightlink.io/canberra

RightLink markets explicitly to Canberra business owners, offering practical automation with measurable outcomes. They integrate into existing software rather than forcing a stack change, including Microsoft 365, Xero, ServiceM8, HotDoc, Cliniko, and MYOB.
